jobs.description:
As a production worker early shift, you play a key role in the production process of meat products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities include:

 
• Supplying the production line with meat products.
 
• Trimming and cutting meat where necessary to ensure every product meets quality standards.
 
• No knife experience? No problem! Full training is provided on the job.
 
• Assisting with the loading and unloading of goods.
 
• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.

Jobomschrijving

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
•  15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Our client, located in the Kortrijk region, is a global producer of textile machinery.

No two days are exactly the same. As a CNC Turner/Miller, you can expect the following responsibilities:

You set up and operate CNC turning and milling machines with the required precision. Throughout the production process, you monitor the automated machines closely and make adjustments whenever necessary.

Quality is key: you check finished parts and ensure they meet the required standards. You also review measurement results, identify deviations and communicate them to the responsible person.

By monitoring the automatic operation of the production cell, you help prevent downtime and ensure a smooth production flow.

 
• 
You have a strong technical interest and work with precision.

 
• 
You have an eye for quality and detail.

 
• 
You have experience with Fanuc and Mazak systems.

 
• 
You have previous experience in the metal industry as a turner/miller.

 
• 
You enjoy working in a team, while also being able to work independently.

 
• 
You are willing to work in a two-shift system: 5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.

 
• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch, French or English to follow the training successfully.

Are you willing to help us accelerate towards a carbon neutral economy? Are you passionate about energy and do you have the potential to grow with us towards the best energy utility ? Are you an ENGINEER? Then ENGIE, leader of the Energy Transition, wants to meet YOU!
 
ENGIE is committed to promote Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging. We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel.
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
 

Jobomschrijving

• For the operations & maintenace of our power plants or for our renewable operations (wind mills/hydro/batteries), we are mainly looking for industrial and civil engineers in electro-mechanics, mechanics, chemistry, physics or electronics who are fluent either in Dutch/French and English.
• For our engineering firm (Tractebel) we are looking mainly for Dutch speakers with:
• a master in civil engineering and a focus either on infrastructure projects or structural engineering
• a master in engineering with professional experience in road, water and/or civil engineering
• For our sales and energy management teams we are looking for either Dutch/French people with fluency in English and who have power market understanding and good analytical, data and AI skills.

You recognise yourself in the following behaviors:

• genuine care for the safety and wellbeing of yourself and your colleagues
• open & curious to understand other’s perspectives even when your own's are challenged
• ready to prioritise and simplify processes
• able to request and give feedback
• make decisions & deliver results
Research shows that men apply when they met 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. However, we are looking for potential, not perfection. So apply today!

As an Air Export Agent, you play a key role in the smooth handling of international air freight shipments. You coordinate export operations from start to finish, ensuring accurate documentation and timely execution. With a strong focus on quality and compliance, you translate regulations and procedures into efficient daily practices. Y

As an Air export agent you're responsible for the following tasks:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system
• Track and trace Air export files as required
• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for export shipments
• Ensure arrival notices are communicated to overseas and customers
• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.
• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards
• Ensure all customers' standard operating procedures are followed and updated
• Meet KPI standards, as per the company procedures
• Keying of air import shipment according to the KPI s and customer's requirements.
• Release files according to KPI and customer requirements in compliance with all rules and regulations
• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

The Air Export Agent we're looking for has the following profile:

• 2 years related experience
• Bachelors degree
• Understanding of air documentation process is needed
• Effective interpersonal skills, including proven abilities to listen, comprehend, effectively communicate clearly and concisely to obtain positive results
• Pro-active, strong organizational skills
• Good computer skills (Excel, Word)
• IATA certification (preferred)
• Fluent in English and a good level of Dutch
• Eligible to work in Belgium

jobs.description:
Our client is a logistics service provider based in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Technical Superintendent or maritime engineer with a passion for inland shipping, vessel management, and technical operations? Do you speak German fluently and enjoy working closely with crews and shipyards?

This is your opportunity to take a key role in managing a modern inland fleet in the Antwerp region.

Your Role as Technical Superintendent

As a Technical Superintendent Inland Shipping, you are responsible for the technical performance, maintenance, and reliability of the fleet. You act as the crucial link between crew, suppliers, and management.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Monitor the technical condition and operational performance of vessels	
• Plan and coordinate maintenance, repairs, and inspections	
• Visit vessels regularly (2–3 times per week)	
• Provide technical support to crews and build strong working relationships	
• Handle technical incidents and breakdowns (on-call rotation)	
• Manage and execute technical projects, refits, and upgrades	
• Develop and follow up on preventive maintenance plans (PMS)	
• Maintain contact with shipyards, suppliers, and classification societies	
• Manage the technical budget and advise on long-term investments

Your Profile:
	
• Bachelor’s degree in Maritime Technology, Electromechanics, or Engineering	
• Proven experience as a Technical Superintendent / Vessel Manager (preferably inland shipping)	
• Fluent in German and English (mandatory requirement)	
• Knowledge of ship engines, propulsion systems, and electrical installations	
• Experience with PMS systems and technical documentation	
• Familiar with classification rules and maritime regulations	
• Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mentality	
• Excellent communicator, able to connect with technical teams and crew	
• Flexible and willing to travel frequently

Our client is a fast-growing Belgian company operating in the food industry. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, we are currently looking for an Application Support Analyst to strengthen their IT Applications team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on professional who enjoys working closely with end users, optimizing business applications, and contributing to the continuous improvement of business processes.

As an Application Analyst / IT Support, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and continuous improvement of the company's business applications.

Acting as the first point of contact for application-related issues, you will support users, coordinate improvements, and contribute to the evolution of the organization's application landscape:

• Provide first-line support to internal users for business applications.
• Analyze and resolve application-related incidents, escalating where necessary.
• Manage and maintain business applications.
• Follow up on change requests, software updates, and application improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to reporting, data management, and process optimization projects.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners across multiple sites.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the IT applications environment.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in application support, application management, functional analysis, or a similar role.
• Experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management (FSCM) and/or Navision is considered a strong asset.
• Experience with or interest in Power BI, reporting solutions, and EDI/API integrations is a plus.
• Service-oriented mindset with a genuine willingness to help end users.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, hands-on, and capable of taking ownership.
• Team player with excellent communication skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for a Purchase Order Manager. You will report to the Finance Manager.

This is not a procurement role. Instead, it is a finance-focused position where accounting knowledge, financial controls and process governance are essential.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

• 
Partner closely with Accounting to support accurate financial reporting, month-end close and reconciliation activities.

• 
Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality operations.

• 
Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and business integration projects.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of Purchase-to-Pay processes, financial controls and operational efficiency.

• 
Act as the key contact for Finance Operations, providing expert support to internal stakeholders.

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in accounting, finance, economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
Several years experience in accounting/controlling.

• 
3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

• 
SAP MM/FI, S/4HANA, advanced Excel, and strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

Our client is an international player in the animal health sector, active in innovative health solutions for companion animals, farm animals and other animal categories. The company operates in a Benelux context and combines a global, science-driven environment with a local culture described as open, collaborative, family-oriented and focused on learning and development.

The organisation is committed to animal well-being and follows a broader One Health vision, recognising the strong link between the health of animals, people and the planet.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Digital Growth Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
• Oversee and optimise e-commerce platforms to enhance user experience and performance.
• Monitor and analyse key metrics to identify growth opportunities.
• Collaborate with the marketing team to create engaging online campaigns.
• Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.
• Stay updated on digital trends and implement innovative solutions.
• Provide regular performance reports and actionable insights to stakeholders.
• Manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns.

As a successful Digital Growth Specialist you should have:

• A degree in marketing, e-commerce, or a related field.
• At least 2 years of e-commerce experience.
• Proven experience in digital marketing and e-commerce management.
• Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance.
• Proficiency in relevant tools and platforms for digital marketing and e-commerce. (bol.com, Amazon,...)
• Excellent project management and organisational skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Familiar with SEO and digital ads.
• Fluent in Dutch, English and good knowledge of French.
• Affinity with animals is a plus.

Our client is a prestigious American law firm located in Ixelles, Brussels, recognised for its international presence and collaborative culture. The Brussels office offers a dynamic, multicultural working environment where excellence, precision, and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting attorneys through accurate data management and research. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing, organising, and maintaining large datasets using advanced Microsoft Excel functionalities.
• Performing complex data analysis using Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and other advanced Excel features.
• Ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of legal and business-related information.
• Conducting research and compiling information to support ongoing legal matters.
• Preparing reports, summaries, and data files for attorneys and internal stakeholders.
• Reviewing and updating databases with a high level of accuracy.
• Collaborating closely with legal teams to ensure deadlines are met and information is properly documented.
• Identifying inconsistencies and proactively improving data quality and processes.

The ideal candidate is analytical, organised, and enjoys working with data in a structured environment.

You have:

• A bachelor's degree (Business Management, Economics, Finance, Business Administration, or any other relevant field).
• A native level of English, both written and spoken.
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, and data manipulation.
• Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
• A proactive mindset and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
• Previous experience working with large datasets or in an analytical, administrative, legal, financial, or business support environment is considered an asset.

Please note: Applicants must already be based in Belgium and have the legal right to work in Belgium. Unfortunately, relocation or visa sponsorship is not available for this position, as the preferred start date is late August or early September.
